home_title: Japan Travel Skills — Japan itinerary planning for AI agents
home_description: Plan and check Japan itineraries with read-only Agent Skills. Look up rail and bus routes, hotels and food, and share an interactive map or presentation brief.
article0_description: Check a Japan itinerary with an AI agent for closures, last admission and tight rail or bus connections. Keep fixed bookings and source links.
article1_description: Turn a Japan itinerary into an interactive HTML map and PowerPoint handoff. Open a Kyoto–Nara demo and generate both views from one plan.
example_description: Switch dates to follow the stops and connections, then filter hotels, sights or food. This illustrative plan includes candidate choices and checks still to make.
example_frame: Interactive Kyoto and Nara itinerary demo
hokuriku_description: Follow a six-day plan from Nagano through Hokuriku. See the draft, two corrections, dated rail examples, and hotel candidates near Kanazawa Station.
